property_summary: For every call to play() with any msg.value, the reference C either leaves pot unchanged or resets it to 0 after paying out exactly the ticket (TICKET_AMOUNT) aggregated across callers (i.e., pot is always a sum of exact ticket-sized contributions when not reset), whereas the mutant that allows msg.value >= TICKET_AMOUNT can change pot by accepting larger-than-ticket payments and thus produce pot values not attainable by the reference (so there exists some msg.value that makes pot differ).
change_summary: Change the require to allow different msg.value, causing different increments to pot and thus different final pot after play.
